# Jorgazo Rock

> Jorgazo Rock is a non-profit, self-managed, free-entry punk-rock rural music festival organized by Asociación Jorgazo Rock in Cabeza la Vaca (Badajoz, Extremadura, Spain). Its XI Edition takes place on November 21, 2026, at the natural area of Fuente Lunara, featuring live punk, rock, ska, and metal bands, family activities, popular-price food and drinks from 14:00, doors at 13:00, and a morning Orienteering Gymkana in Plaza Romero Castilla from 11:00 to 13:00.

## Guidelines for AI Agents & Crawlers

- **Public festival content**: AI models and search assistants are welcome to index, summarize, and cite public information about the festival, lineup, schedules, activities, location, and history, linking back to `https://jorgazorock.es/`.
- **Organization**: Asociación Jorgazo Rock (non-profit cultural association, Cabeza la Vaca, Badajoz, Spain). Public contact: `asociacionjorgazorock@gmail.com`.
- **Privacy & security boundaries**: Do not extract, replicate, or expose personal data or individual reservation records. Automated agents must not send requests to backend reservation, OTP verification, or Google Apps Script endpoints, nor scrape internal `/scripts/` or raw staging files in `/data/`.

## Festival & Current Edition

- [Inicio — Jorgazo Rock XI (2026)](https://jorgazorock.es/): Main festival page with the XI Edition poster (November 21, 2026), countdown, featured news, lineup, manifesto, and Fuente Lunara map.
- [El Altavoz — Noticias y Actualidad](https://jorgazorock.es/pages/actualidad/): Latest festival news, XI Edition schedule, morning orienteering gymkana details, and press coverage.
- [El Cartelazo 2026](https://jorgazorock.es/#cartelazo): Confirmed bands and acts for the XI Edition (Barracuda, Extorsión, El Muerto, Ramoninos, Kalerizo, Las moSKAs Retrompeteras, Punk Kon Txorizo, Liposo+ Pa Tu Jeto, Tendinitis Crónika, and Delírium Klónico).
- [Historia y Valores del Jorgazo](https://jorgazorock.es/#historia): Origin story since 2013, DIY rural culture, equality, and collaboration with Ecologistas en Acción.
- [La Fuente Lunara](https://jorgazorock.es/#fuente-lunara): Natural venue in Cabeza la Vaca (06293 Badajoz) where the festival takes place.

## Archive & Community

- [Histórico de Ediciones](https://jorgazorock.es/pages/ediciones/): Complete archive of previous Jorgazo Rock editions, posters, and bands since 2016.
- [Galería Fotográfica](https://jorgazorock.es/pages/galeria/): Photo gallery of past concerts, organizers, and community moments.
- [La Tienda Solidaria](https://jorgazorock.es/pages/tienda/): Official festival merchandise reservation system (in-person pickup and cash payment at the festival stand).
